function.name: transfer_task
function.arguments: {"agent": "writer", "task": "Generate one sentence about microVMs", "expected_output": "A single sentence describing microVMs"}

tool_definition.name: transfer_task
tool_definition.description:
Use this function to transfer a task to the selected team member.
            You must provide a clear and concise description of the task the member should achieve AND the expected output.

agent.description: The name of the agent to transfer the task to.

task.description: A clear and concise description of the task the member should achieve.

expected_output.description: The expected output from the member (optional).
